name: PDF Generator
description: Generate dynamic PDF documents with custom text lines using the fpdf library.

configuration.description: Generates a basic PDF document and saves it locally.

code_content:
from langchain_core.tools import tool

@tool
def generate_pdf_doc(title: str, content: str) -> str:
    """Generates a custom PDF document containing the specified title and content body text."""
    # Safe in-memory fpdf usage for generating document layout
    from fpdf import FPDF
    pdf = FPDF()
    pdf.add_page()
    pdf.set_font('Arial', 'B', 16)
    pdf.cell(40, 10, title)
    pdf.ln(12)
    pdf.set_font('Arial', '', 12)
    pdf.multi_cell(0, 10, content)
    output_path = 'generated_doc.pdf'
    pdf.output(output_path, 'F')
    return f'PDF successfully created and written to {output_path}'
